acceptance.text: A CHECK_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE refusal additively names the sandbox_start.* check and bounded cause when the declared check's last recorded attempt refused with PROCESS_START_FAILED. Today applyCheckEvidence (internal/driver/checkevidence.go:313-320) calls submitCheckEvidenceIncompleteError(check) (:318-319, built at submission_refusal_detail.go:192-198) with only the declared check's own name in Paths; the sandbox detail is already lost before that point, because session.bash's recordCheckEvidence (checkevidence.go:42-68) derives its Diagnostic from checkResultOutcome (:112-129), which for any ContractError falls through to contractErrorCode(runErr) (:131-137) - and contractErrorCode returns only contractErr.Code, discarding contractErr.Detail entirely. A PROCESS_START_FAILED whose Detail already carries the six-way check name and bounded kernel cause (failSandboxStart, sandbox_start_detail.go:94-99, and failSandboxStartCause, :107-115, built from the closed vocabulary at :31-49 and sandboxStartCause at :64-77) is therefore recorded as the bare string 'PROCESS_START_FAILED', and the sandbox information never reaches the refusal the model, the journal, or an e2e observer sees. Pinned by a driver-package unit test asserting a CHECK_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE refusal's Detail names the sandbox_start.* check and cause when the last recorded attempt at the declared check carries a PROCESS_START_FAILED entry.

test/e2e's production-journey rerun-cap diagnostic renders the sandbox cause the refusal now names instead of a fixed guess. Today production_journey_linux_test.go:251-254 always formats 'evidence rerun cap for %s: check %q still uncovered after %d re-runs (sandbox starts likely failing)' - a hardcoded parenthetical, not a read of anything - because it extracts only the declared check name via journeyNamedCheckPattern (:680, regex `check [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+`) from the check_evidence_incomplete refusal body, and the refusal it reads carries no sandbox information to extract (see A1). After this slice the harness renders the named sandbox_start.* check and cause when the refusal carries one, and falls back to the existing guess text only when it does not. Pinned by an e2e test (test/e2e, in-process httptest mock at :963, no external network) that drives a sandbox-start failure through to the rerun cap and asserts the resulting error names the sandbox check and cause rather than the fixed string.

TestKilledHostMidDriveRecoversCleanly's lease/sleep margin is widened so a loaded runner cannot race the takeover into finding a still-live lease. Today main_test.go:1111 sets SWORN_TEST_OWNER_LEASE_MILLIS=500 and :1122 sleeps exactly 700ms before calling takeover - a 200ms margin between when the lease is defined to expire and when the test acts on that assumption - the same shape of timing pin PR #276 (6375a327) already widened twice in this suite (surface_parity_linux_test.go's 60s and 120s post-answer completion polls, both missed on unchanged code under hosted-runner load and passing every time locally, matched instead to the file's own 240s answer-acceptance tolerance) rather than tied to any contract. sworn#263 and sworn#277 cite 6 of 8 hosted CI runs red on this class in one day, never locally. Pinned by TestKilledHostMidDriveRecoversCleanly (main_test.go:1059-1157) itself, whose margin constants change and whose single-succeeded-merge-effect assertion (:1147-1156) must still hold.

constraints: The retry policy of #264 is untouched: cleanSetupExit and the attempt<2 loop (internal/driver/tools_linux.go:592-597) keep deciding which sandbox-start modes retry and how many times; this slice only surfaces a cause a refusal already carries, it never changes retry behaviour.

The closed sandbox_start.* check vocabulary (sandbox_start_detail.go:31-49) and its bounded, secret-free cause extraction (sandboxStartCause, :64-77) are reused exactly as built for #264, never redefined, renamed, or widened to a seventh site.

The CHECK_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE refusal's existing shape (Bound check_command_covers, Paths naming the one declared check) is extended additively only: an existing consumer that reads the declared-check name is unaffected, and no new terminal state or outcome vocabulary is introduced.

No secret or host path escapes the widened Detail: any sandbox cause surfaced here still passes through sandboxStartCause's syscall.Errno-only extraction and the maxSandboxStartCauseBytes/revalidateSandboxStartDetail bound (sandbox_start_detail.go:13, :117-145) unchanged - nothing about that bound loosens.

Host-declared checks are out of scope: they run via exec.Command on the host, never through bwrap (internal/runtime/host_checks.go), so their free-text Diagnostic is untouched and internal/runtime is not edited by this slice.
